subject: accepted paper describing Stan in J Stat Software - missing from Stan's citation page

messages.author: b4e15e3dc2e504d2
messages.subject: accepted paper describing Stan in J Stat Software - missing from Stan's citation page
parts:
Bob:

The Stan webpage previously listed this accepted paper but now does not. I thought it would be an appropriate to reference to Stan in addition to the Stan language reference. But now the accepted paper is no longer listed. Should I still cite it?

Thanks

Steve


Stan: A Probabilistic Programming Language. Bob Carpenter, Andrew Gelman, Matt Hoffman, Daniel Lee, Ben Goodrich, Michael Betancourt, Marcus A. Brubaker, Jiqiang Guo, Peter Li, and Allen Riddell. Journal of Statistical Software. (2015 in press).

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] accepted paper describing Stan in J Stat Software - missing from Stan's citation page
parts:
Up to you.

The paper's been "conditionally accepted", which I think means
it's just down to formatting now. JStatSoft's taken 4--6
months for each turnaround, so a 2015 publication date is optimistic.

It was probably a version control SNAFU that removed it from
the site. I'll put it back up. We need to overhaul that whole page,
but I'm buried in to-do items right now.

- Bob
